packageRules.description: The runner and its Docker image must move together (npm run check:docker-image), and visual baselines are tied to the image's browsers.
prBodyNotes: Regenerate visual baselines in this PR: `npm run test:visual:update`, then review the image diffs. If the test agent definitions changed upstream, regenerate them as described in docs/ai-assisted-testing.md.

packageRules.description: Toolshop is the application under test; a new image can change behaviour, accessibility and screenshots, so updates wait for approval on the dependency dashboard.
